selectedStories.title: Rockets beat Pacers 119-104 as Alperen Sengun leaves with eye and face injury
selectedStories.summary: SB Nation reports Kevin Durant scored 21 points and Reed Sheppard hit six three-pointers off the bench for 20 as the Rockets beat the Pacers 119-104. Sengun was poked in the eye and hit in the face and did not return, and Houston head coach Ime Udoka said he’s not sure how much time Sengun will miss. Pacers coach Rick Carlisle was ejected, and Marcus Smart exchanged words with a fan.

selectedStories.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo scores 27 as Heat beat Bucks 137-130
selectedStories.summary: Giannis Antetokounmpo had 27 points, 14 rebounds and nine assists in the Miami Heat's 137-130 win over the Milwaukee Bucks, and said the game "was as special as every other night." Heat coach Erik Spoelstra said Antetokounmpo is "really allowing our offense to grow." Bam Adebayo added 26 points.

selectedStories.title: Kings rookie Darius Acuff Jr. scores 36 points, joining Oscar Robertson in NBA history
selectedStories.summary: Kings rookie Darius Acuff Jr. scored 36 points in a performance that, per the Yardbarker headline, joins him with Oscar Robertson in NBA history. The Kings continue struggling to find victories.

selectedStories.title: Luka Doncic takes blame after Lakers' loss to Jazz
selectedStories.summary: Luka Doncic shouldered blame after the Lakers' loss to the Jazz, saying "This is unacceptable from my part." It was the Lakers' first loss in November and just the third of the season.

selectedStories.title: Wizards end eight-game losing streak with win over depleted Raptors
selectedStories.summary: SB Nation reports the Wizards ended their losing streak at eight by beating the Toronto Raptors in Canada, with Dybantsa and Davis powering the win. Toronto was missing its three best players and lost another member of its top six four minutes into the game.
